captions.detailed: A bar-top video poker terminal featuring a dark, compact cabinet with an angled upper screen housing colorful digital display graphics. On the horizontal control shelf in front of the screen, five circular, brightly colored play buttons are lined up horizontally (red, orange, green, blue, red). Below this control shelf, a recessed cash-out slot is visible with a dark flap. The five individual buttons can be pressed downward as independent prismatic controls, while the lower slot flap is hinged to rotate outwards.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a bar-top video poker terminal. The model should feature a main dark cabinet with an angled screen displaying colored rectangular graphics, a front control shelf with five aligned circular buttons of varying colors (red, orange, green, blue, red), and a recessed lower cash-out tray with a hinged flap. Define independent prismatic joints for each of the five buttons to simulate vertical pressing, and a revolute joint for the lower tray flap.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet body using a combination of Box primitives, cutting a recess for the lower tray. Model the screen frame using an angled Box, adding thin colored boxes for the display graphics. Create five cylindrical buttons on the control shelf, assigning each a distinct Material color. Define five independent 'prismatic' joint articulations for the buttons moving along the Z-axis, and a 'revolute' joint for the lower tray flap using a bottom-hinge axis of rotation.
